reuse.why: Parameterises the existing getEditableCategories / filter used by the five category-list actions, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own hand-rolled hidden check and only gets the flag patched into it.

duplication.why: The hidden-category rule (and now its include flag) still lives in two forms, the SQL filter and copyPreviousMonth's JS condition; the diff extends both rather than unifying them, though it introduces no new copies of its own.

placement.why: The flag is handled in actions.ts in the shared filter builder, and the args type is shared via MonthWideArgs so handler types flow through typeof.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and their shared filter are touched.

maintainability.why: Clean parameter threading and a named shared arg type; the remaining split between SQL and JS hidden rules means a future rule change still has two places to edit.
